messages:
Lina: quick sync: final preflight for EdgeCloud + Stratus marketplace listing. we have 4 lanes: listing assets, SI badge + cert, joint comms + embargo, and billing flow. who owns what?
Marco: i'll do the listing metadata + canonical URLs. aiming to finish slug+meta by 4pm PT.
Priya: marketing owns blog + partner quote collection. blog draft 700-900 words, publish-ready assets by Thu noon. need partner quote signed by Fri.
Design•Jordan: will produce hero, 2 CTAs comps (trial/contact SI), and a compact badge spec. expect assets by 6pm.
Sam (Product): confirming trial flow flag = partner_trial opt-in. need finance to confirm partner_billing option. Priya, Marco, loop finance.
Stratus•Amy: Stratus update: security questionnaire submitted today, functional test harness in progress. target to complete integration tests by EOD Fri.
LegalBot: proposed embargo window 2026-04-16 08:00 PT. partners must sign NCO by EOD Friday or we stagger. note: quotes require comms signoff before publish.
Lina: adding runbook for clarity:
```
RUNBOOK: EdgeCloud+Stratus Marketplace Preflight
- Metadata & Slugs: owner=Marco, due=Today 4pm PT, sheet=Marketplace_SKUs_v3
- Hero + Screens: owner=Design•Jordan, due=6pm PT, path=drives/marketplace/edge-stratus/hero
- Blog Draft: owner=Priya, due=Thu 12pm PT, include 1 partner quote
- Badge Spec + PNG: owner=Design•Jordan, 120x40 + SVG, due=6pm PT
- SI Cert Matrix: owner=Stratus•Amy, tests ETA=Fri EOD
- Billing Mode: owner=Sam (Product) + Finance, decision by Tomorrow 11am PT
- Embargo Signoff: owner=LegalBot, partners confirm by Fri COB
- Staging Push: owner=PlatformOps, scheduled=2026-04-15 23:00 PT
- Dry Run: 30min preflight call 2026-04-16 09:00 PT (ops+infra+partner)
```
Marco: i'll add redirect rules for trial promos; plan 301s -> live after embargo.
Priya: question: hero CTA — A/B test Start free trial vs Contact SI? i'd prefer trial for PLG, but Stratus pushed for Contact SI. any objections?
Lina: default to Start free trial. contact SI as secondary for enterprise-only customers. we'll A/B test on 25% traffic.
Stratus•Amy: can Marketing add a short integration quote: "Stratus integration with Redwood Inference made deployment seamless" — i can route to comms for signoff.
Design•Jordan: uploading hero comps + badge variants now -> https://drive.redwood/marketplace/edge-stratus (files: hero_v1.png, hero_v2.png, badge_color.png, badge_mono.svg)
LegalBot: redlined MSA addendum posted in drive; partners must ACK changes in the doc before embargo.
Sam (Product): finance flagged partner-managed billing requires additional accounting fields. looping in finance DM.
Lina: action items: everyone update the shared sheet with GO/NO-GO toggle. we'll run the dry run Wed 09:00 PT. react with :white_check_mark: when your row is complete.
